about: The monthly county rain email ask on the county rain pages. {county} is the county's name as the page prints it. live true: the county pages show it.
ask: Email me {county}’s rain at the start of each month.
ok: Done. It comes on the 2nd of each month, with the month just ended.
note: One short email a month: the month and the year so far against usual, at this page’s station. Stop any time.
